about: Names that were left in Chinese inside English strings of data/en (no official English in names.json / glossary.json). Our translation by meaning (people's and place names romanized), applied by translate/unofficial.py at the end of build_en.py and listed per record in i18n.unofficial_names. They are UNOFFICIAL names; the site shows them with an 'unofficial name' mark and the Chinese in a tooltip. Wiki typos are translated as written, never corrected (note says what it probably means). 'game dictionary #id' = an exact entry with the same Chinese exists in the game files (2026-09-22) and fits the context; it is still not verified that the game uses it for this thing.
